# Welcome to SCpubr {#default_title .unnumbered}

<img src="images/logo.png" class="mx-auto d-block" style="box-shadow: none; width: 100%">

Welcome to the official documentation for **SCpubr v3.0.0**!

`SCpubr` provides a streamlined way of generating publication-ready plots for **S**ingle-**C**ell transcriptomics data. The goal is simple: create high-quality visualizations with minimal effort that can be used right away in your research articles.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Design philosophy
Every `SCpubr` function is designed so that **basic usage requires only a Seurat object and, at most, a few key parameters**. Sensible defaults handle the rest. When finer control is needed, each function exposes a rich set of optional parameters for advanced customization — colors, typography, legends, rasterization, and more — documented in the [shared features reference](00_getting_started/03_shared_features.qmd).
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Maintenance mode
**SCpubr** is now in maintenance mode — bug fixes and compatibility updates will continue, but no new features are planned. Community contributions are very welcome! See the [contributing guide](08_appendix/02_contributing.qmd) for how to get involved.
:::

## What's new in v3.0.0?

- **34 functions** organized into 6 logical categories
- **Colorblind-safe palettes** built-in
- **Standardized naming** across all functions
- **Enhanced compatibility** with SeuratObject v5
- **Text values** in heatmaps for better readability

Check the full [changelog](#version-history) for details.
